title: LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Michigan Admission Ticket
includes: Admission to Legoland Discovery Center Michigan
Food and drinks (available for purchase) (not included)
Master Build Academy (available for purchase) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note: As a children's attraction and to promote a safe and family-friendly environment, adults cannot enter without being accompanied by a child
Children must wear socks in the soft play area
policies: The last entry to the attraction is at 3:30 PM (with doors closing at 5:00 PM)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unleash your kids' creativity at LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Michigan, a family-friendly indoor LEGO® playground packed with fun attractions. Explore a virtual LEGO Factory, discover iconic Metro Detroit landmarks in Miniland, and build with soft bricks at the DUPLO® Farm. Enjoy exciting LEGO rides like Merlin’s Apprentice and relax at the 4D cinema for a full day of unforgettable LEGO® adventures.
